finding.Swole: normalizeSwoleMap checks mapping event/expiry at normalization but drops both from price_comparability. Zone expiry uses only model event+TTL; a converted zone can remain selectable after its mapping expires.
finding.Hyperliquid: Native zone expiry already min(native expiry,mapping expiry,mapping event+priceTTL). Missing mapping event/expiry in price_comparability prevents independent final lineage proof.
finding.Orderly: Source generation event is unknown; documented source-asof bound is diagnostic. Normalizer emits observations with event_ts/expires_ts null, usablefalse and zones[]. Do not promote it.

Swole effective expires_ts becomes min(native model expiry,mapping expiry,mapping event+unchanged priceTTL); native_expires_ts preserves original model bound.
Swole and HL copy qualified mapping event_ts/expires_ts into existing price_comparability object. Unknown mapping produces null clocks.
No registry, route, identity, proof predicate, unit, source TTL, model TTL, optional budget, runtime, analytics or delivery mutation.

lineage.verified_static: lineage() copies event/received/expiry and entire price_comparability object into components. Selected/merged zone expiry is min(all component expiry). Therefore proposed nested mapping clocks survive existing selected-zone lineage without an analytics change for copying.
lineage.limitations: lineage() does not copy every top-level identity/model proof reference. ROOT/ANALYTICS must retain or resolve exact protected originals for proof checks; do not infer these refs from a representative component. Publication must inspect every selected component, not only parent/newest. native_expires_ts is also not copied by current component lineage; effective expires_ts and event_ts are copied. Recompute native bound from each event plus the pinned basis TTL, or resolve that exact protected original; never substitute the representative's native expiry.

checks: Validate actual selected components for source clock/received/TTL/expiry and asset/basis/proof eligibility at final publication, after waits and before send.
For cross-venue components validate nested mapping status/evidence/markets/target/currencies/multiplier and independent mapping event/priceTTL/expiry. Missing legacy clocks fail that proof.
Use conservative minimum across all displayed components, including dedup/merge lineage. Parent mapping fields alone cannot represent every member.

Do not send immutable enriched text whose displayed zones have expired. Optional-map absence alone must not block an otherwise valid signal: ROOT owns a fresh consistent mapless immutable text/analysis/hash path or refusal of that enriched version; stale map references/confluence cannot remain.
Preserve source_input and actual send/ACK times for readback. A pre-enqueue check is not send-time proof; this source patch alone cannot prove freshness on Telegram receipt or after network delay.
ROOT_required_consumer.boundary: Source normalizers/selectZones retain existing inclusive expiry equality. ROOT owns any stronger send-latency margin; no TTL relaxation or invented arrival timestamp.

bounded_behavior.stale_native: Swole returns STALE/empty; HL marks stale observations unusable. New receipt cannot rejuvenate source.
bounded_behavior.missing_or_future_native: Swole existing clock failure; HL existing PARTIAL/ERROR with unusable output. No receipt fallback.
bounded_behavior.stale_unqualified_mapping: Existing mappingKnownfalse; diagnostic native bounds may remain but usablefalse and no exact BingX zone. Qualified zone later past effective expiry must not be displayed.
bounded_behavior.absence: NO_VERIFIED_ROUTE/NOT_CHECKED and WITHOUT_MAP remain nonblocking by explicit owner amendment.
bounded_behavior.requests: No automatic refresh/retry/search to repair missing proof. Existing bounded source arrays/accounts, deadlines, caps and paid/unknown costs unchanged.

affected_validation.plan: ROOT one separately admitted targeted source→selected lineage/publication case group; no old full suite, Node or engine run here.
affected_validation.static_checks: Pinned local source bytes verified against main Git blobs; patch generated in memory, original canonical files unchanged. Timestamp/deadline arithmetic checked administratively.

acceptance: Necessary source-field and expiry proposal for ROOT's final publication guard; not deployed, not native acceptance and not complete end-to-end Telegram freshness proof.
preservation: BingX900/day27900/month10/min1/sec80% plan; TG47/day1457/month;3manual/day; all spent/unknown/holds/reserves/9pauses/2OWNERdeferrals retained. No raw IDOL/private16, no IDOL causal inference.
